#### 9.3 Frisoli 2025 — TMVR Through Prior ASD Occluder for Mitral Bioprosthesis Degeneration

[PMID 41106893](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41106893/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

68 歲女 — 7 年前 SAVR + ASD closure (Amplatzer ASD Occluder 24 mm) + 10 年前 mitral bioprosthesis (Mosaic 27 mm)。現 mitral bioprosthesis severe stenosis (MVA 1.0 cm², gradient 14 mmHg)。Surgical re-do 風險高 (STS 11%)。**Trans-septal access through previously implanted ASD occluder** — 8.5F Mullins sheath punctured the polyester mesh of Amplatzer disc; serially dilated with 12/16/20 mm peripheral balloon。植入 SAPIEN 3 29 mm via valve-in-valve TMVR；residual ASD post-procedure 4 mm（preserved circulation through occluder mesh），no LV–RA shunt。

**教學重點**:
> **Trans-septal puncture through an existing ASD/PFO occluder is feasible** when no alternative septal real estate is available — the polyester mesh accommodates large-bore TMVR sheath after sequential balloon dilation. Plan needle entry at the junction of mesh-and-disk for stable wire purchase.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Trans-septal puncture into the body of pre-existing Amplatzer ASD occluder under ICE guidance。](../images/tavi-complications/41106893_Frisoli_2025/fig-01_p3.png)

![Serial balloon dilation (12 → 16 → 20 mm) of the puncture tract through occluder mesh。](../images/tavi-complications/41106893_Frisoli_2025/fig-02_p3.png)

![SAPIEN 3 29 mm valve-in-valve mitral TMVR deployment via the dilated trans-occluder tract。](../images/tavi-complications/41106893_Frisoli_2025/fig-03_p4.png)

![Post-procedure 3D TEE: well-seated mitral SAPIEN; residual 4 mm ASD without significant shunt。](../images/tavi-complications/41106893_Frisoli_2025/fig-04_p4.png)
:::

#### 9.4 Heller 2025 — From Severe AS to Mitral TEER: Overcoming SAVR Complicated With LVOTO

[PMID 40615174](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40615174/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

71 歲女 severe AS + moderate MR + sigmoid septum。SAVR 後 (21 mm Inspiris) 出現 **acute LVOTO with severe SAM-mediated MR**（resting LVOT gradient 65 mmHg, MR severe）— ECMO-supported recovery 7 天，後選擇 **mitral TEER (PASCAL Ace)** 鎖定 A2/P2 leaflets，A2 leaflet 被「綁回」中央位置 → SAM resolved (後 LVOT gradient 18 mmHg)，MR 由 severe 降至 trace。

**教學重點**:
> Post-SAVR SAM-mediated MR with LVOTO can be **rescued by mitral TEER** — clipping A2/P2 prevents the anterior leaflet from being drawn into the LVOT, breaking the SAM cycle. PASCAL's slim profile + independent leaflet capture is well suited for this delicate scenario.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-SAVR TTE: severe AS + sigmoid septum (MV-aortic angle narrow)。](../images/tavi-complications/40615174_Heller_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Post-SAVR acute LVOTO physiology — SAM with severe MR by 3D TEE。](../images/tavi-complications/40615174_Heller_2025/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![ECMO support during haemodynamic recovery, awaiting TEER。](../images/tavi-complications/40615174_Heller_2025/fig-03_p3.jpeg)

![Mitral TEER deployment — PASCAL Ace at A2/P2 region。](../images/tavi-complications/40615174_Heller_2025/fig-04_p4.jpeg)

![Post-TEER 3D TEE: SAM abolished, dual orifice, MR trace only。](../images/tavi-complications/40615174_Heller_2025/fig-05_p5.jpeg)

![Discharge TTE: LVOT gradient 18 mmHg, MR mild。](../images/tavi-complications/40615174_Heller_2025/fig-06_p6.jpeg)
:::

#### 9.5 Jo 2025 — Mavacamten for LVOTO After Successful TAVI

[PMID 40054912](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40054912/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

72 歲女 severe AS + asymmetric septal hypertrophy。SAPIEN 3 23 mm 植入後當下 LVOT gradient 35 mmHg；6 週後 dyspnea 復發，TTE 顯示 progressive **LVOTO with SAM** — gradient 上升至 95 mmHg。Metoprolol + verapamil 加到 max dose 仍不足。啟動 **mavacamten 5 mg PO daily**（cardiac myosin inhibitor）—6 個月後 LVOT gradient 降至 22 mmHg, NYHA III → I。

**教學重點**:
> Post-TAVR dynamic LVOTO can develop **delayed (weeks to months)** as LVH remodels asymmetrically. **Mavacamten** is a novel disease-modifying option when β-blockers + Ca-blockers fail to control gradient — particularly attractive in elderly TAVR cohort intolerant of polypharmacy.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-TAVR TTE: severe AS + asymmetric septal hypertrophy (IVS 17 mm)。](../images/tavi-complications/40054912_Jo_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Immediate post-TAVR: mild LVOT gradient 35 mmHg。](../images/tavi-complications/40054912_Jo_2025/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![6-week TTE: SAM with severe LVOT gradient 95 mmHg。](../images/tavi-complications/40054912_Jo_2025/fig-03_p4.jpeg)

![Post-mavacamten 6 months: SAM resolved, gradient 22 mmHg。](../images/tavi-complications/40054912_Jo_2025/fig-04_p4.jpeg)

![Functional improvement: NYHA III → I; KCCQ +28 points at 6 months。](../images/tavi-complications/40054912_Jo_2025/fig-05_p5.jpeg)
:::

#### 9.6 Kim 2025 — Delayed Mitral Prosthesis Dehiscence Following TAVR

[PMID 40780803](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40780803/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

76 歲女 — 8 年前 mechanical MVR (St. Jude 27 mm)，後接 TAVR (Evolut Pro+ 26 mm) for severe AS。TAVR 後 14 天 acute pulmonary edema — TEE 顯示 **mitral prosthesis posterior paravalvular dehiscence** (3 mm gap, severe MR)。**Mechanism**: TAVR self-expanding frame radial force outward into MV-aortic curtain，剝離 mitral prosthetic ring 縫線。Plug closure with **AVP III 12×5 mm** via trans-septal — paravalvular leak resolved。

**教學重點**:
> **Mitral prosthesis dehiscence is a rare but underappreciated late complication of TAVR** — the self-expanding frame's continuing radial expansion can disrupt prior mitral surgical sutures, especially with high implantation depth. Pre-TAVR CT must include detailed mitro-aortic curtain assessment in patients with prior MVR. AVP III plug closure works well via trans-septal route.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Pre-TAVR CT: mechanical MVR (St. Jude 27 mm) with prosthetic ring; mitro-aortic curtain。](../images/tavi-complications/40780803_Kim_2025/fig-01_p3.png)

![Post-TAVR day 14 TEE: posterior mitral paravalvular dehiscence — 3 mm gap with severe MR。](../images/tavi-complications/40780803_Kim_2025/fig-02_p4.png)

![Trans-septal AVP III plug deployment into the dehiscence tract。](../images/tavi-complications/40780803_Kim_2025/fig-03_p4.png)

![Post-closure 3D TEE: PVL trace only, well-seated AVP III plug。](../images/tavi-complications/40780803_Kim_2025/fig-04_p5.png)
:::

#### 9.7 Mengi 2025 — Live Hemodynamics-Assisted Simultaneous Aortic + Mitral ViV

[PMID 40750182](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40750182/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

81 歲男 — 12 年前 SAVR (Magna Ease 23 mm) + MVR bioprosthesis (Magna 27 mm)。雙瓣膜均出現 structural valve degeneration（aortic peak gradient 75 mmHg, mitral gradient 14 mmHg, MR moderate）。STS 13%。**Strategy**: simultaneous aortic + mitral ViV with **live LV-Ao + LA-LV pressure monitoring** — first deploy mitral SAPIEN 3 26 mm (trans-septal)，then aortic SAPIEN 3 23 mm (transfemoral)，每步均查看 4-chamber pressures 確認 no LVOTO。Final: aortic gradient 8 mmHg, mitral gradient 4 mmHg, no LVOTO。

**教學重點**:
> **Concurrent dual-valve ViV** is high-risk for LVOTO due to the additive frame protrusion. **Live multi-chamber pressure monitoring (LV, Ao, LA)** allows real-time SAM/LVOTO detection at each deployment step. Sequence: mitral first (creates the hardest anatomy change), then aortic — abort or retreat if gradient unacceptable.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-procedural TEE: severe degenerated aortic and mitral bioprostheses。](../images/tavi-complications/40750182_Mengi_2025/fig-01_p3.png)

![CT planning: predicted neo-LVOT after dual-ViV; angle and septal hypertrophy assessed。](../images/tavi-complications/40750182_Mengi_2025/fig-02_p4.png)

![Live LV (red) + Ao (yellow) + LA (green) tracings during sequential deployment。](../images/tavi-complications/40750182_Mengi_2025/fig-03_p5.png)

![Mitral ViV (SAPIEN 3 26 mm) deployed first via trans-septal route。](../images/tavi-complications/40750182_Mengi_2025/fig-04_p6.png)

![Aortic ViV (SAPIEN 3 23 mm) deployed second via TF route。](../images/tavi-complications/40750182_Mengi_2025/fig-05_p7.png)

![Final fluoroscopy: dual SAPIEN frames seated; final gradients aortic 8 mmHg, mitral 4 mmHg。](../images/tavi-complications/40750182_Mengi_2025/fig-06_p8.png)
:::

#### 9.8 Polat 2025 — Strategic Prosthesis Selection for Staged TAVI + Mitral Surgery

[PMID 40155144](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40155144/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

68 歲女 severe AS + severe MR (STS 9%, surgically high-risk for SAVR + MV repair)。Heart Team 選擇 **staged hybrid approach**: (1) TAVR with **SAPIEN 3 23 mm** (specifically chosen for low-profile, balloon-expandable to minimise LVOT encroachment for future mitral surgery)；(2) 6 個月後 minimally invasive mitral repair via right mini-thoracotomy — uneventful。**Critical pre-op planning**: SAPIEN 3 frame height 18 mm vs. self-expanding ~45 mm — 後者可能干擾 future mitral surgical visualisation 與 chord access。

**教學重點**:
> **TAVR prosthesis choice matters when staged mitral surgery is anticipated** — short-frame balloon-expandable (SAPIEN 3) preserves anatomical landmarks and surgical access for subsequent MV repair, whereas long-frame self-expanding may obstruct visualisation and chord manipulation.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-procedural CT: severe AS + severe MR; mitro-aortic angle measured for prosthesis selection。](../images/tavi-complications/40155144_Polat_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Stage 1 — SAPIEN 3 23 mm TAVR: short-frame design preserves access for future MV surgery。](../images/tavi-complications/40155144_Polat_2025/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Stage 2 — minimally invasive mitral repair via right mini-thoracotomy 6 months later。](../images/tavi-complications/40155144_Polat_2025/fig-03_p4.jpeg)
:::

#### 9.9 Tsutsui 2025 — Peri-Mitral Atrial Tachycardia Following TAVR

[PMID 40118607](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40118607/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

79 歲男 severe AS — TAVR (Evolut Pro+ 29 mm) 後 3 週 incessant **peri-mitral atrial tachycardia** (cycle length 280 ms, 2:1 AV block)。EP study：activation map 顯示 macro-reentrant loop 圍繞 mitral annulus，**critical isthmus 在 mitral isthmus / left fibrous trigone**。 假說：TAVR self-expanding frame 對 left fibrous trigone 造成 mechanical irritation 或 myocardial fibrosis trigger arrhythmia。Successful **mitral isthmus ablation** (RA → LA via trans-septal) — endocardial + epicardial (via CS) lines — sinus rhythm restored。

**教學重點**:
> **Peri-mitral atrial tachycardia is an underrecognised post-TAVR arrhythmia**, especially with deep self-expanding implantation impinging on the left fibrous trigone. Mitral isthmus ablation (mid lateral mitral annulus → LIPV) requires both endocardial and CS-epicardial lesion sets to achieve durable conduction block.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Post-TAVR ECG: incessant atrial tachycardia, cycle length 280 ms, 2:1 AV conduction。](../images/tavi-complications/40118607_Tsutsui_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![3D activation map: macro-reentrant circuit around mitral annulus; critical isthmus at left fibrous trigone region。](../images/tavi-complications/40118607_Tsutsui_2025/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Successful mitral isthmus ablation: endocardial RF line + CS epicardial line — conversion to sinus rhythm。](../images/tavi-complications/40118607_Tsutsui_2025/fig-03_p4.jpeg)
:::

#### 9.10 Bielichenko 2024 — Hybrid Robotic MVR + TAVR for Post-Radiation Disease

[PMID 39619031](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39619031/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2024

58 歲女 — Hodgkin lymphoma 過去縱膈放射治療 30 年。Severe radiation-induced AS + MR + extensive aortic root calcification + porcelain ascending aorta。Conventional sternotomy 高風險（mediastinal fibrosis, redo-like）。**Hybrid strategy**: (1) **Robotic mitral valve replacement** via right thoracotomy (Inspiris 25 mm)；(2) 4 週後 **TAVR** (Evolut Pro+ 26 mm) via transfemoral — porcelain aorta avoidance critical。

**教學重點**:
> **Post-radiation valvular disease is an ideal substrate for hybrid robotic + transcatheter approach** — avoids the calcified/fibrotic mediastinum entirely. Sequence: surgical mitral first (technically harder), then TAVR for the AS — both via non-sternotomy approaches.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Pre-procedural CT: porcelain ascending aorta, severe radiation-induced valvular disease, mediastinal fibrosis。](../images/tavi-complications/39619031_Bielichenko_2024/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Stage 1 — robotic mitral valve replacement via right thoracotomy (Inspiris 25 mm)。](../images/tavi-complications/39619031_Bielichenko_2024/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Stage 2 (4 weeks later) — Evolut Pro+ 26 mm TAVR via transfemoral, porcelain aorta avoided。](../images/tavi-complications/39619031_Bielichenko_2024/fig-03_p4.jpeg)

![Final TTE at 6 months: both prostheses well-seated, no significant gradient。](../images/tavi-complications/39619031_Bielichenko_2024/fig-04_p4.jpeg)
:::

#### 9.11 Fang 2024 — LAVA-ECMO–Supported Dual TAVR + TMVR ViV in Cardiogenic Shock

[PMID 39484326](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39484326/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2024

70 歲男 — 早年 SAVR + MVR bioprostheses；現 cardiogenic shock with severe degeneration of both（aortic gradient 60 mmHg, mitral gradient 16 mmHg, MR moderate, LVEF 25%）。**LAVA-ECMO** (Left Atrial Veno-Arterial ECMO — femoral A + transseptal LA cannula) initiated to bypass LV pre-procedurally — provides forward flow + LV unloading concurrent with ViV deployment。Sequential dual ViV: SAPIEN 3 23 mm aortic + SAPIEN 3 29 mm mitral via trans-septal。LV recovers, ECMO weaned at 72 h。

**教學重點**:
> **LAVA-ECMO is a creative MCS strategy for high-risk dual-ViV** — combines forward flow (peripheral V-A) with LV unloading (trans-septal LA cannula), avoiding both Impella's coaxial concerns and traditional V-A ECMO's afterload increase. Particularly suited for low-EF + multi-valve disease.

::: {layout-ncol=3}

![Aortic ViV deployment under LAVA-ECMO support — SAPIEN 3 23 mm。](../images/tavi-complications/39484326_Fang_2024/fig-03_p5.jpeg)

![Mitral ViV via trans-septal — SAPIEN 3 29 mm。](../images/tavi-complications/39484326_Fang_2024/fig-04_p6.jpeg)

![ECMO weaned 72 h post-procedure; LV recovered to LVEF 40%。](../images/tavi-complications/39484326_Fang_2024/fig-05_p7.jpeg)

#### 9.12 Koliastasis 2023 — Suicide LV After TAVR

[PMID 38094179](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38094179/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2023

82 歲女 severe AS + small LV cavity (LVEDD 36 mm) + EF 75% — TAVR (SAPIEN 3 23 mm) 後 24 h **acute "suicide LV" physiology**：refractory hypotension, dynamic LVOT obstruction (gradient 80 mmHg), severe SAM。Mechanism: 前的 chronic afterload reduction (TAVR resolves AS) + small hyperdynamic LV → cavity obliteration during systole。Rescue: aggressive **IV fluid bolus 2 L** + **phenylephrine** (avoid inotropes which worsen LVOTO) + **esmolol drip** — gradient 降至 25 mmHg over 6 h; full recovery by 48 h。

**教學重點**:
> **Suicide LV after TAVR**: small hyperdynamic LV + sudden afterload reduction → mid-cavity / LVOT obstruction. Rescue is **counter-intuitive** — give volume + α-agonist + β-blocker; **avoid inotropes** which worsen the obstruction. Pre-op identify high-risk anatomy (LVEDD <40 mm, septal hypertrophy, EF >70%).

::: {layout-ncol=3}

![Continuous arterial line: refractory hypotension before counter-intuitive rescue。](../images/tavi-complications/38094179_Koliastasis_2023/fig-03_p3.jpeg)

![Post-rescue: SAM abolished after volume + phenylephrine + esmolol。](../images/tavi-complications/38094179_Koliastasis_2023/fig-04_p4.jpeg)

![48 h follow-up TTE: gradient resolved to 18 mmHg, EF normal。](../images/tavi-complications/38094179_Koliastasis_2023/fig-05_p4.jpeg)

![Discharge — patient ambulant, NYHA I。](../images/tavi-complications/38094179_Koliastasis_2023/fig-06_p5.jpeg)
:::

#### 9.13 Sammour 2021 — Transcatheter Closure of LVOT-to-LA Fistula

[PMID 34317621](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34317621/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2021

74 歲男 — 之前 SAVR (Magna 23 mm) + MVR (St. Jude 27 mm)。現 progressive HF — TEE 顯示 **LVOT-to-LA fistula** at the mitro-aortic curtain (3 mm jet), generated by gradual erosion of intervalvular fibrosa between the two prostheses。Surgical re-do prohibitive。**Transcatheter closure**: trans-septal access → wire across the fistula tract → AVP II 8×7 mm plug deployed → fistula sealed。

**教學重點**:
> **LVOT-to-LA fistula at the mitro-aortic curtain** is a rare late complication of dual surgical valve replacement — chronic mechanical erosion of the intervalvular fibrosa. AVP II plug closure via trans-septal route is feasible. Important to verify with TEE that the plug does not impinge on either prosthesis or AV node.

## 10. Cardiac tamponade / Pericardial / Ventricular perforation

> **教學重點**：TAVR procedural tamponade 多由 pacemaker lead perforation、stiff wire LV perforation、annular rupture 引起。輻射心臟病合併 constrictive physiology 是術前評估的重要 confounder。

**案例庫共 1 篇**（已下載 1）。

---

#### 10.1 Al-Dalakta 2025 — Radiation-Induced Cardiac Disease: TAVR vs SAVR + Pericardiectomy Dilemma

[PMID 40579075](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40579075/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

61 歲女 — Hodgkin lymphoma s/p chest radiation 25 年前。Severe AS + concomitant **constrictive pericarditis** (RHC: equalisation of diastolic pressures, square-root sign) + radiation-induced mediastinal fibrosis。Heart Team dilemma — single TAVR 不解決 constrictive physiology；SAVR + pericardiectomy 是 ideal 但 redo-style sternotomy + radiation field 高風險。**Final**: TAVR (Evolut Pro+ 26 mm) + medical management of constriction (diuresis, gentle volume control)；3 個月 follow-up — symptomatic improvement，避開 sternotomy。

**教學重點**:
> **Radiation-induced cardiac disease is a Pandora's box** — AS + constriction + restrictive physiology + porcelain aorta. TAVR addresses only AS; constrictive physiology persists. Inform the patient that staged or non-surgical strategy is symptom-palliative, not curative. Surgical pericardiectomy carries high mortality in this cohort.

## 11. Iatrogenic VSD / Septal injury / Fistula — 醫源性心室中膈缺損與分流

### 概念與機轉

TAVR 後的 **acquired intracardiac shunt (AICS)** 發生率約 **0.5–1%**，包含 iatrogenic VSD、aorto-RV fistula (ARVF)、LVOT-to-LA fistula 與 Gerbode (LVOT/LV-to-RA) defect。三大機轉：

1. **Balloon 部署時的 calcium translocation** — 球囊撐脹時把 right coronary cusp / aortic root wall 的 focal calcification 經 basal aortic wall 向外推擠，造成 aortic root / annulus 撕裂 → 多形成 **aorto-RV fistula**（balloon-expandable valve 風險高，self-expanding 在 post-dilation 時亦可）
2. **Deep implantation 的 mechanical trauma** — Frame 距離 membranous septum / mitro-aortic intervalvular fibrosa（fibrous curtain）過近，frame strut 或 catheter 對脆弱組織造成穿孔
3. **Bioprosthetic valve fracture (BVF) 的高壓 balloon trauma** — ViV TAVR 為解 patient-prosthesis mismatch 而 fracture 時，高壓球囊可撕裂 mitro-aortic curtain → **LVOT-to-LA fistula**

**處置原則**（依「症狀 + fistula 大小 + 血流動力學」決定）：

- **無症狀 + 小 fistula + RV 正常** → 保守追蹤（利尿、serial echo）
- **有症狀 / 進展 / RV 擴大** → 介入：transcatheter plug（AVP II / AVP IV）、septal occluder、TAV-in-TAV，或 open surgical patch
- 裝置選擇強調 **low-profile**，避免干擾鄰近瓣葉活動或冠狀動脈口

> **特殊族群提醒**：**先天性心臟病（CHD）**病人（如曾自發閉合的 perimembranous VSD）即使無典型 iatrogenic VSD 危險因子（無 oversizing、無 post-dilation、low calcium），閉合處的 aneurysmal 組織仍可能在 TAVR 過程被機械力撕開。Pre-TAVR 應特別影像評估 membranous septum；任何 post-TAVR 新發心衰竭都應以 dedicated LVOT imaging 排除 AICS。症狀性未處置者 mortality 約 25–33%。

**案例庫共 6 篇**（已下載 4 / 待下載 2）。

---

#### 11.1 Sedhom 2026 — Transcatheter Closure of LVOT-to-LA Fistula After Aortic Bioprosthetic Valve Fracture

[PMID 41563190](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41563190/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2026;31:106654

**78 歲男**，病史：13 年前 25 mm St Jude Epic 外科瓣 SAVR（true internal dimension 21 mm），9 年後因 structural valve degeneration 接受 **26 mm Edwards SAPIEN 3 ViV TAVR**（當時未做 valve fracture）。本次發病前 3 個月，因 severe patient-prosthesis mismatch，以 **25 mm True balloon（比瓣內徑大 4 mm）對 TAVR 瓣做 bioprosthetic valve fracture (BVF)**——術中即發生 **LVOT-to-LA fistula**，位於 **mitral-aortic intervalvular fibrosa（fibrous aortomitral curtain）**，posterior aortic cusp 下方、近 lateral trigone，伴 ≥ moderate supra-annular MR（3D vena contracta 0.35 cm²）。因當時無症狀採 watchful waiting。LVEF 40–45%、bioprosthetic AV mean gradient 11 mmHg、無 PVL。其後 **心衰竭症狀復發**（JVD、bibasilar crackles、下肢水腫），invasive 測得 LVEDP 升高。

**處置 — 經皮 transseptal（靜脈側）closure**：10F sheath 經右股靜脈 → TEE 導引 mid/posterior transseptal puncture → telescoping 系統（**8.5F Agilis steerable guide + 5F multipurpose + angled glidewire**）自 LA 跨過 paravalvular defect 進入 LV → 植入 **8 mm Amplatzer IV vascular plug (AVP IV)** → perivalvular leak 消失。術後運動性呼吸困難與心衰竭症狀顯著改善。

**教學重點**:

> **BVF 可撕裂 mitro-aortic intervalvular fibrosa** → LVOT-LA fistula。TAVR 後 fistula 多涉及 interventricular septum 或 aorta-to-RV，**LA 受累屬罕見**。約 50% 病人會出現症狀（心衰竭、溶血、栓塞），closure 適應症為進展性心衰竭、RV 擴大或 Qp:Qs 升高。

> **裝置選擇 — 為何選 AVP IV**：defect 小且緊鄰 native mitral 與 transcatheter aortic 兩組瓣葉。AVP IV 是 low-profile nitinol 裝置，可經任何相容 0.035-inch guidewire 的診斷導管（如 4F multipurpose）輸送，**碟盤小 → 不干擾兩組瓣葉活動**；釋放前可回收重新定位。目前尚無專為 TAVR 後 iatrogenic intracardiac shunt 設計的裝置。

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Visual Summary — 病程時間軸：SAVR → ViV TAVR → BVF → LVOT-LA fistula → 經皮 AVP IV closure。](../images/tavi-complications/41563190_Sedhom_2026/fig-01_p2.png)

![Figure 1 — Balloon valvuloplasty 透視影像：(A) BVF 前 TAVR 瓣、(B) BVF 後 TAVR 瓣。](../images/tavi-complications/41563190_Sedhom_2026/fig-02_p3.png)

![Figure 3 — 跨越 fistula：angled glidewire 經 transseptal、自 LA 跨 fistula 進入 LV。](../images/tavi-complications/41563190_Sedhom_2026/fig-04_p5.png)

#### 11.2 Mason 2025 — Iatrogenic Reopening of a Congenital VSD After TAVR

[PMID 41005845](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41005845/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025;30:105228

**74 歲女**，severe AS（AVA 0.8 cm²、peak gradient 43、mean 33 mmHg），高手術風險 → **29 mm balloon-expandable Edwards SAPIEN S3** TAVR，**未做 post-dilation、無立即併發症**。病史：permanent AF s/p AVN ablation + dual-chamber PPM、HF with recovered EF；幼時被告知「心臟有洞」且雜音後自行消失——實為 **先天性 perimembranous VSD，由 aneurysmal tricuspid valve tissue 自發閉合**。

術後 3 天即因 encephalopathy / hyponatremia / volume overload 入院；其後 6 週又 5 次因失代償心衰竭入院，出現新的 cirrhotic liver morphology、cannon V waves、pulsatile liver。TTE：新發 **moderate perimembranous VSD with L-R shunt**（peak velocity 3.2 m/s、peak gradient 42 mmHg），TAVR 瓣本身位置良好、功能正常。TEE：VSD 由 aneurysmal TV 組織部分閉合，**LV inlet 端 7 mm、RV outlet 端 4 mm**，並新發 **severe TR**。右心導管：mixed pre-/post-capillary PH，**Qp:Qs 1.5 → 利尿後 2.1**。同時發現一個緊鄰 TAVR frame proximal margin 下方的 **iatrogenic LVOT-to-RA (Gerbode) defect**。

**機轉**：先前閉合 congenital VSD 的 aneurysmal tricuspid 組織在 TAVR 過程被 frame / catheter 撕裂（dehiscence）→ 顯著 L-R shunt → 反覆失代償心衰竭與 TR 惡化。值得注意——**典型 iatrogenic VSD 危險因子全數缺席**（AV calcium 低、無 post-dilation、無顯著 oversizing）。

**處置 — 開心手術**：TAVR 後約 2 個月接受複雜開心修補——**VSD patch closure + 修補 dysplastic 三尖瓣瓣葉 + 移除 transvenous pacing leads + 置放 epicardial pacemaker**，Gerbode defect 一併修補。術後 TTE：VSD 完全閉合、Gerbode 僅 trivial 殘餘、mild TR。術後因反覆 pleural effusion 需雙側引流，約 2 週後轉復健；**30 個月**追蹤已停利尿劑、活動良好。

**教學重點**:

> 此為文獻首例「**先天性自發閉合 perimembranous VSD 於 TAVR 後再開放**」所致 AICS。自發閉合處的 aneurysmal TV 組織**機械強度低、隨年齡纖維化變脆**，即使無傳統危險因子也可能被撐開。

> **CHD 病人 pre-TAVR 須詳細結構影像評估 membranous septum**；任何 post-TAVR 新發心衰竭都應立即以 dedicated LVOT imaging 排除 AICS——症狀性未處置者 mortality 約 25–33%，而幾乎所有無症狀者保守觀察預後良好。本例分流被緩慢釐清，致 2 個月內多數時間住院，凸顯早期診斷的重要。

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Figure 1 — (A) Pre-TAVR TTE：perimembranous VSD 由一薄帶 aneurysmal 三尖瓣組織閉合；(B) color Doppler 顯示閉合處無血流；(C) TAVR 後 angiogram，無暫時性 RV pacing lead 跨越三尖瓣。](../images/tavi-complications/41005845_Mason_2025/fig-01_p2.png)

![Figure 2 — TEE：VSD 顯著血流（Vmax 3.2 m/s、peak gradient 42 mmHg）、LV inlet 端 0.7 cm、緊鄰 TAVR 瓣，並見伴隨之三尖瓣逆流。](../images/tavi-complications/41005845_Mason_2025/fig-02_p3.png)

#### 11.3 Chia 2024 — Management of Aorto-Right Ventricular Fistulas After TAVR（三例系列）

[PMID 39619019](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39619019/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2024;29:102655

**3 年內 3 例 aorto-RV fistula (ARVF) 系列**，完整展示「依症狀 + fistula 大小 + 血流動力學」的處置光譜（外科 / 經皮 / 保守）：

| 病人 | 背景 | TAVR 瓣 | Day-1 fistula | Qp:Qs | 處置 | 結果 |
|------|------|---------|--------------|-------|------|------|
| **1** | 78 M，無症狀 high-gradient AS | 26 mm SAPIEN 3 Ultra | 5–6 mm（aortic root→RV inflow） | 1.9 | 原擬保守，但進展性呼吸困難 → **外科**：bovine patch + SAPIEN explant + 23 mm Edwards Perimount | 1 mo 無殘餘分流 |
| **2** | 86 M，症狀性 severe AS | 29 mm SAPIEN 3 Ultra | 5–6 mm（RCC sinus→RV）+ mild PVL | — | 持續呼吸困難 → **經皮 10 mm AVP II plug**（TAV-in-TAV 因恐將鈣化推更深而放棄） | trace 殘餘，1 mo 完全緩解；DAPT 6 mo→ASA |
| **3** | 80 F，4 年前 29 mm Medtronic CoreValve；本次 severe prosthetic valve stenosis | TAV-in-TAV 23 mm SAPIEN 3 Ultra | 小 2–3 mm（RCC sinus→mid-RV） | — | 無症狀、RV 正常 → **保守** serial TTE | Month 1 & 9 無變化、持續無症狀 |

**機轉**：balloon 部署時 **right coronary cusp / aortic root wall 的 focal calcification 經 basal aortic wall transmural translocation** → aortic root / annulus 受傷 → ARVF。三例皆有 **RCC 不對稱緻密鈣化 + 近 right SoV 的 aortic-root-base 鈣化**。Operator 因素：catheter 操作、高球囊壓力、prosthesis oversizing。

**教學重點**:

> **三例對應三種處置策略**——並非「越大越要開刀」的線性規則，而是綜合症狀、fistula 大小、RV 影響與手術風險的個人化決策。無症狀 + 小 fistula + RV 正常可保守追蹤；有症狀 / 進展 / RV 擴大才介入（外科最 definitive、transcatheter plug 較微創、TAV-in-TAV 選擇性使用）。

> **診斷關鍵**：fistula 在 color / spectral Doppler 呈 **systole 與 diastole 皆有的連續血流**（CW Doppler 常 > 4 m/s），藉此與 pulmonic / paravalvular AR 區辨。CTA 評估 fistula 與冠狀動脈口、root 結構之關係；右心導管於 ambiguous 病例可確認分流量。

#### 11.4 Masarweh 2024 — TAVR-Related Aorto-RV Fistula Repaired Via Valve-in-Valve

[PMID 38264302](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38264302/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2024;29:102165

**59 歲男**，severe AS 於 **3 年前接受 TAVR（Edwards Sapien 瓣）**；HF with recovered EF（30–35% → 60%）、s/p biventricular ICD、paroxysmal AF、T2DM、CKD 3B。本次以 **NYHA IV 雙側心衰竭 1 個月**表現（全身水腫、腹脹、anasarca、ascites），**BNP 2,955 pg/mL**。

影像：TTE 顯示 AVA 1.3 cm²、peak velocity 2 m/s、EF 60%、mild-to-moderate AI，以及 **aorto-RV communication**；TEE 確認瘻管自 right coronary cusp 鄰近 sinus 通往 RV；CT 量得 annulus 32 × 30.4 mm、面積 772 mm²；心導管見 **oxygen step-up**（RV sat 71%、PA sat 82%）。

**處置 — ViV TAVR 一箭雙鵰**：因手術風險高、同時有 AR 與 aorto-RV fistula，heart team 決定以第二個 TAVR 瓣同時處理瓣膜逆流與瘻管。植入 **Evolut Pro Plus 34 mm（Medtronic）於既有 Edwards Sapien 瓣之內**，以原瓣為 landmark **landing 在原瓣略下方**；pre-CT 冠狀動脈高度 L 19.4 / R 22 mm，確保不擋冠狀動脈口。rapid pacing 下部署並 post-dilate。**瘻管仍 patent，但血流顯著減少**（非完全封閉）。此為文獻首例以 ViV 方式修補 aorto-RV fistula。

追蹤：2 週後 NYHA I–II、BNP 降至 358 pg/mL。計畫持續觀察，若惡化再考慮 percutaneous coiling 或 surgical patch。

**教學重點**:

> **ViV TAVR 可作為「同時處理瓣膜逆流 + 瘻管」的創意解法**——第二個瓣的 frame / sealing skirt 可減少瘻管血流，特別適用於 prohibitive surgical risk 且 fistula 位於原 frame 層級、傳統 plug 不易進入者。

> **務必先評估冠狀動脈高度**：ViV 可能擋住冠狀動脈口；本例藉「landing 在原瓣略下方」保護冠狀動脈。ARVF 機轉多為 contained annular rupture / 鈣化位移（以 balloon-expandable 為主）。注意**血流是「減少」而非完全消失** → 需持續影像追蹤。

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Figure 1 — Cardiac CT 矢狀面：連接 aorta（近 right sinus）與 RV 的瘻管（箭頭）。](../images/tavi-complications/38264302_Masarweh_2024/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Figure 2 — CT 顯示左右冠狀動脈口高度與既有 TAVR 瓣之關係（規劃 ViV landing 深度）。](../images/tavi-complications/38264302_Masarweh_2024/fig-02_p3.jpeg)
:::

## 12. Multi-valve / Concurrent / Combined procedures (TAVR + TEER/PBPV/TEVAR/SAVR)

> **教學重點**：Multi-valve disease 在 TAVR cohort 越來越常見。Concurrent / staged 策略選擇取決於：(1) acuity, (2) anatomic interaction（mitro-aortic curtain, prosthesis-prosthesis interaction），(3) surgical risk。**One-stop**（同次混合手術）可降低 ICU/hospital stay 但增加 immediate complexity。

**案例庫共 6 篇**（已下載 6）。

---

#### 12.1 Khan 2025 — Surgical Reintervention for Complex Multivalvular Rheumatic Heart Disease

[PMID 41136032](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41136032/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

55 歲女 — rheumatic heart disease s/p MVR (mechanical) 15 年前。Now severe AS + severe TR + severe pulmonary HTN。Prior failed TAVR attempt at outside hospital — failed due to mechanical MVR distortion of aortic annular geometry。**Surgical re-intervention** strategy: (1) re-do sternotomy, (2) bioprosthetic AVR + tricuspid annuloplasty (Carpentier ring 28 mm), (3) preserve mechanical MVR。 STS predicted mortality 18% — actual hospital course uneventful, discharged D9。

**教學重點**:
> **Some patients are not TAVR candidates** despite high surgical risk — multi-valve rheumatic disease with mechanical MVR distorting aortic annular geometry is one such anatomy. Surgical reintervention with experienced team can outperform predicted STS mortality. Key lesson: **rule out TAVR before pursuing it** — pre-procedural CT-based annular assessment is mandatory.

::: {layout-ncol=1}
![Pre-operative CT and surgical findings: rheumatic AS + TR + mechanical MVR distorting aortic annulus — surgical re-intervention with bioprosthetic AVR + tricuspid annuloplasty。](../images/tavi-complications/41136032_Khan_2025/fig-01_p3.png)
:::

---

#### 12.2 Nandhakumar 2025 (Clinical) — Prosthetic Heart Valve Interactions in Transcatheter Left-Sided Double Valve Replacement

[PMID 40250932](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40250932/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

68 歲男 — degenerated SAVR + MVR bioprostheses。Concurrent ViV in both positions (aortic SAPIEN 3 23 mm + mitral SAPIEN 3 26 mm)。Demonstrates **prosthesis-prosthesis interaction**: aortic ViV deployed first → mitral ViV deployed → 3D TEE showed **aortic ViV partially compressed by mitral frame** (frames touching at intervalvular fibrosa)。Aortic gradient acceptable (12 mmHg) but valve geometry asymmetric。Long-term implications uncertain — close echo follow-up at 6 mo, 1 y, 2 y。

**教學重點**:
> **Frame-frame interaction is a real concern in dual ViV** — 3D TEE post-deployment must verify that neither prosthesis is mechanically compressed. Pre-procedural CT can predict interaction risk by measuring intervalvular fibrosa thickness + planned frame heights.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Pre-procedural CT: degenerated SAVR + MVR bioprostheses; intervalvular fibrosa thickness measurement。](../images/tavi-complications/40250932_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Sequential aortic + mitral ViV deployment under fluoroscopy。](../images/tavi-complications/40250932_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-02_p4.jpeg)

![Post-deployment 3D TEE showing aortic ViV asymmetric compression by adjacent mitral frame。](../images/tavi-complications/40250932_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-03_p6.jpeg)

![6-month follow-up echo: stable gradients, no progressive deformation。](../images/tavi-complications/40250932_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-04_p7.jpeg)
:::

#### 12.3 Nandhakumar 2025 (Bench) — Prediction of Prosthetic Heart Valve Interaction Using Bench Model

[PMID 40250946](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40250946/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

**Bench-top experimental study** — 3D-printed dual-valve heart phantoms with varying mitral-aortic distances (12, 15, 18 mm)。Tested all combinations of SAPIEN 3 + Evolut + ACURATE neo2 in aortic and mitral positions。**Key findings**: (1) **mitro-aortic distance <14 mm** → frame interaction inevitable; (2) self-expanding (Evolut) in aortic position has highest deformation when mitral SAPIEN 3 deployed second; (3) sequence matters — deploy short-frame (SAPIEN) first, long-frame (Evolut) second to minimise interaction。

**教學重點**:
> **Pre-procedural bench testing with patient-specific 3D-printed models** is emerging best practice for complex multi-valve TAVR. Mitro-aortic distance <14 mm is a red flag. Frame combination + sequence both matter. This bench study validates clinical practice patterns for double-ViV scheduling.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![3D-printed heart phantoms: varying mitro-aortic distances (12, 15, 18 mm)。](../images/tavi-complications/40250946_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Test combinations: SAPIEN 3 + Evolut + ACURATE neo2 in aortic and mitral positions。](../images/tavi-complications/40250946_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Frame deformation imaging post-dual deployment: Evolut shows highest distortion when mitral SAPIEN deployed second。](../images/tavi-complications/40250946_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-03_p4.jpeg)

![Hydrodynamic test: gradient and regurgitation across each combination。](../images/tavi-complications/40250946_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-04_p5.jpeg)

![CT cross-section of bench-tested combinations showing frame-frame contact。](../images/tavi-complications/40250946_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-05_p6.jpeg)

![Decision matrix: when to choose SAPIEN-first vs. Evolut-first sequencing based on mitro-aortic distance。](../images/tavi-complications/40250946_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-06_p7.jpeg)

![Long-term simulation: cyclic loading on dual-ViV combinations。](../images/tavi-complications/40250946_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-07_p8.jpeg)

![Recommended pre-procedural workflow: patient CT → 3D print → bench test → procedural plan。](../images/tavi-complications/40250946_Nandhakumar_2025/fig-08_p8.jpeg)
:::

#### 12.4 Sami 2025 — Alpha-Gal Syndrome and AVR

[PMID 41106900](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41106900/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

64 歲男 severe AS — confirmed **alpha-gal syndrome** (anti-galactose-α-1,3-galactose IgE antibody mediated allergy) with documented anaphylaxis to mammalian meat products。**Clinical concern**: bovine/porcine bioprosthetic valves (SAPIEN, Mosaic, Magna) contain alpha-gal epitope → potential immune-mediated valve degeneration / anaphylaxis。**Strategy**: discussion of (1) mechanical AVR (avoids alpha-gal entirely; requires lifelong VKA); (2) bovine TAVR with peri-procedural antihistamine + steroid prophylaxis; (3) Inspiris RESILIA bovine valve (anti-calcification treatment may reduce alpha-gal exposure but data limited)。Patient elected mechanical SAVR (On-X 23 mm)。

**教學重點**:
> **Alpha-gal syndrome is a rare but underrecognised contraindication to bioprosthetic valves**. Pre-procedural allergy testing should be considered in patients with known mammalian-meat allergy. Mechanical AVR avoids the issue entirely. Limited data on TAVR with prophylaxis — case-by-case decision.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-procedural allergy testing: skin-prick + serum specific IgE confirms alpha-gal sensitisation。](../images/tavi-complications/41106900_Sami_2025/fig-01_p2.png)

![Heart Team discussion: mechanical AVR vs. bioprosthetic with prophylaxis。](../images/tavi-complications/41106900_Sami_2025/fig-02_p3.png)

![Mechanical AVR (On-X 23 mm) — avoids alpha-gal entirely。](../images/tavi-complications/41106900_Sami_2025/fig-03_p4.png)
:::

#### 12.5 Tan 2025 — One-Stop TEVAR and TAVR for Severe AS + Aortic Arch Aneurysm

[PMID 40252063](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40252063/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

75 歲男 severe AS + asymptomatic 65 mm aortic arch aneurysm。Heart Team approached the dual problem with **one-stop hybrid procedure**: (1) **TEVAR** with custom branched stent-graft for arch aneurysm coverage (preserved supra-aortic vessels via fenestration), (2) immediately followed by transfemoral **TAVR** (Evolut Pro+ 26 mm) through the freshly-implanted graft。Total procedure time 3.5 hours. ICU stay 2 days. Discharged D7。

**教學重點**:
> **One-stop hybrid TEVAR + TAVR is feasible** for AS + arch aneurysm — saves a second procedure but requires meticulous CT planning of stent-graft landing zone (must accommodate TAVR delivery sheath retrograde traversal). The fresh graft's inner luminal smoothness facilitates TAVR sheath passage.

#### 12.6 Zhang 2025 — Simultaneous TAVR and PBPV in Multiple Valve Disease

[PMID 39972698](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39972698/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

71 歲女 — congenital aortic stenosis + severe pulmonary stenosis (PSpeak 95 mmHg)。**Simultaneous procedure**: (1) **PBPV** (percutaneous balloon pulmonary valvuloplasty) with 23 mm Tyshak balloon — pulmonary gradient 95 → 22 mmHg；(2) **TAVR** with SAPIEN 3 23 mm — aortic gradient 75 → 8 mmHg。Concomitant approach selected to address both fixed and dynamic afterload simultaneously, avoiding sequential general anaesthesia exposures。

**教學重點**:
> **Simultaneous TAVR + PBPV** is appropriate when both valves are stenotic and contributing to symptoms — single anaesthesia, addresses biventricular afterload concurrently. PBPV is technically simpler than TAVR; perform PBPV first to unload RV before TAVR.

![Final fluoroscopy: TAVR seated, PBPV result confirmed。](../images/tavi-complications/39972698_Zhang_2025/fig-04_p5.jpeg)

![Post-procedural TTE: aortic gradient 8 mmHg, pulmonary gradient 22 mmHg。](../images/tavi-complications/39972698_Zhang_2025/fig-05_p6.jpeg)

## 13. Bicuspid / Special anatomy / Small annulus / Horizontal aorta

> **教學重點**：Bicuspid AS、small annulus、horizontal aorta、coarctation 等 special anatomies 在 TAVR planning 需特殊考量。Sizing strategy 可採 supra-annular vs. annular；deployment 角度與 wire support 需個別 customise；severely calcified bicuspid 可能需 IVL pre-treatment。

**案例庫共 8 篇**（已下載 8）。

---

#### 13.1 Hu 2026 — AS + AR Combined With Aortic Coarctation

[PMID 41641912](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41641912/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2026

48 歲男 — congenital bicuspid AS + AR + previously undiagnosed **aortic coarctation** (peak gradient 65 mmHg at descending aorta)。Heart Team strategy: (1) **CoA stenting first** with covered stent (16×40 mm Cheatham-Platinum) — gradient 65 → 8 mmHg; (2) **TAVR** with SAPIEN 3 26 mm 2 weeks later via transfemoral through the new stent。Both procedures uneventful。

**教學重點**:
> **Coarctation must be treated before TAVR** in TF approach — un-treated CoA both (a) creates haemodynamic gradient that masks AS severity, and (b) prevents safe TF access. Staged approach (CoA stent → TAVR) is preferred over one-stop to allow vascular healing.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-procedural CTA: bicuspid AS + AR + aortic coarctation, gradient 65 mmHg。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-01_p3.png)

![Coarctation site under angiography — peak gradient 65 mmHg。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-02_p3.png)

![CP covered stent 16×40 mm deployment under fluoroscopy。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-03_p4.png)

![Post-CoA stent angiography — gradient down to 8 mmHg。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-04_p4.png)

![CTA at 2 weeks: stable CoA stent, ready for TAVR。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-05_p5.png)

![TAVR 2 weeks later — TF sheath traverses through fresh CoA stent。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-06_p5.png)

![SAPIEN 3 26 mm deployment under rapid pacing。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-07_p6.png)

![Post-TAVR angiography: AS resolved, AR mild, valve well-seated。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-08_p6.png)

![Final fluoroscopy: dual-procedure result with coarctation stent + aortic valve。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-09_p6.png)

![3-month follow-up CTA: stable both interventions。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-10_p6.png)

![6-month echo: durable result, NYHA III → I。](../images/tavi-complications/41641912_Hu_2026/fig-11_p7.png)
:::

#### 13.2 Annabathula 2025 — TAVR for Valvular Shock in Extremely Large Annulus

[PMID 40155146](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40155146/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

71 歲男 — **valvular cardiogenic shock** from severe AS。Pre-procedural CT: aortic annulus 34 mm × 40 mm (perimeter 116 mm) — **extremely large annulus exceeding largest commercial valve sizing**。Off-label strategy: **SAPIEN 3 29 mm + balloon over-expansion** with 31 mm volume balloon (10 mL extra inflation) → frame achieves 31 mm OD; mild PVL acceptable; haemodynamic stabilisation achieved。

**教學重點**:
> For **extremely large annuli (>30 mm)**, off-label balloon over-expansion of SAPIEN 3 29 mm with extra inflation volume is a salvage option. Trade-off: PVL risk increases. Cardiogenic shock with no time to refer can justify off-label use; document Heart Team consensus.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-procedural CT: extremely large aortic annulus 34×40 mm, perimeter 116 mm。](../images/tavi-complications/40155146_Annabathula_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Cardiogenic shock with severe AS by TTE; haemodynamic instability。](../images/tavi-complications/40155146_Annabathula_2025/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![SAPIEN 3 29 mm deployment with balloon over-expansion (10 mL extra)。](../images/tavi-complications/40155146_Annabathula_2025/fig-03_p3.jpeg)

![Post-deployment angiography: mild PVL only, well-seated。](../images/tavi-complications/40155146_Annabathula_2025/fig-04_p4.jpeg)

![Final TTE: AS resolved, mild PVL, EF improved。](../images/tavi-complications/40155146_Annabathula_2025/fig-05_p5.jpeg)

![Discharge: stable haemodynamics, NYHA IV → II。](../images/tavi-complications/40155146_Annabathula_2025/fig-06_p5.jpeg)
:::

#### 13.3 Liang 2025 — TAVR in Severe Horizontal Heart With Acute Aortic Angulation

[PMID 40379374](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40379374/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

83 歲女 — severe AS with **horizontal heart** (LV-aorta angle 65°, normally <30°)。Conventional TAVR delivery system has difficulty achieving coaxial alignment。**Strategy**: (1) extra-stiff Lunderquist wire for support; (2) ACURATE neo2 (self-expanding, slow controlled deployment well-suited for angulated anatomy); (3) **buddy-balloon over-the-wire technique** — second balloon catheter as deflector to redirect delivery system axis。Successful coaxial deployment, mild PVL only。

**教學重點**:
> **Horizontal heart (>50° angle) is technically challenging for TAVR** — conventional balloon-expandable + standard wire often non-coaxial. Strategies: (1) extra-stiff wire (Lunderquist), (2) self-expanding valve (slow controlled deployment), (3) buddy-balloon deflector, (4) consider transapical / transcaval if TF non-feasible.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-procedural CT: severe horizontal heart, LV-aorta angle 65°。](../images/tavi-complications/40379374_Liang_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![ACURATE neo2 with Lunderquist wire + buddy-balloon deflector technique。](../images/tavi-complications/40379374_Liang_2025/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Post-deployment fluoroscopy: coaxial alignment achieved, mild PVL only。](../images/tavi-complications/40379374_Liang_2025/fig-03_p4.jpeg)
:::

#### 13.4 Liu 2025 — Procedural Strategies for TAVR With Small Aortic Annulus

[PMID 40252065](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40252065/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

68 歲女 — severe AS + **small aortic annulus** (perimeter 65 mm, area 320 mm²) — high risk for prosthesis-patient mismatch (PPM)。**Strategy comparison**: (1) supra-annular self-expanding (Evolut FX 23 mm) — preserves effective orifice area；(2) annular balloon-expandable (SAPIEN 3 20 mm) — lower profile but smaller EOA。Heart Team chose Evolut FX 23 mm based on body surface area (1.45 m²) — predicted EOA 1.4 cm², iEOA 0.97 cm² (no PPM)。

**教學重點**:
> **Small annulus + small body size → choose supra-annular self-expanding** to maximise effective orifice area and prevent PPM. Pre-procedural EOA calculation based on patient BSA is critical. Severe PPM (iEOA <0.65) doubles 5-year mortality.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-procedural CT: small aortic annulus, perimeter 65 mm, area 320 mm²。](../images/tavi-complications/40252065_Liu_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Sizing analysis: Evolut FX 23 mm vs. SAPIEN 3 20 mm — predicted EOA comparison。](../images/tavi-complications/40252065_Liu_2025/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Evolut FX 23 mm deployment with supra-annular leaflet position。](../images/tavi-complications/40252065_Liu_2025/fig-03_p4.jpeg)

![Post-deployment angiography: well-seated, supra-annular leaflets。](../images/tavi-complications/40252065_Liu_2025/fig-04_p5.jpeg)

![Final TTE: peak gradient 12 mmHg, mean 8 mmHg, EOA 1.4 cm², iEOA 0.97 cm² (no PPM)。](../images/tavi-complications/40252065_Liu_2025/fig-05_p6.jpeg)

![Long-term follow-up: durable haemodynamics, NYHA improvement。](../images/tavi-complications/40252065_Liu_2025/fig-06_p7.jpeg)

![Decision algorithm: small annulus + BSA → supra-annular preference。](../images/tavi-complications/40252065_Liu_2025/fig-07_p8.jpeg)
:::

#### 13.5 Peng 2025 — Bailout for Balloon Entrapment in Type 0 Bicuspid AS

[PMID 41386941](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41386941/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

62 歲男 — **type 0 bicuspid AS** with raphe-free, two equal commissures, heavily calcified leaflets。During pre-dilation **balloon (23 mm True Balloon) entrapment** between calcified leaflet edges — balloon could not deflate fully due to leaflet calcium hooking。**Bailout**: (1) over-the-wire snare (15 mm Amplatz Goose Neck) advanced from contralateral femoral; (2) snare grasping balloon catheter shaft; (3) coordinated deflation + traction → balloon retrieved intact。Subsequent TAVR with Evolut Pro+ 26 mm successful。

**教學重點**:
> **Balloon entrapment in heavily calcified bicuspid valves** — calcium spurs may hook the balloon waist preventing complete deflation. Bailout: contralateral femoral snare + coordinated traction. Prevention: lower-pressure pre-dilation in heavy calcium; consider **IVL pretreatment** (see Rehan 2025 below).

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Type 0 bicuspid AS with heavy calcium spurs — pre-procedural CT。](../images/tavi-complications/41386941_Peng_2025/fig-01_p3.png)

![Balloon entrapment + contralateral femoral snare retrieval bailout — fluoroscopy sequence。](../images/tavi-complications/41386941_Peng_2025/fig-02_p3.png)
:::

#### 13.6 Qin 2025 — Type 0 Severe Calcified Bicuspid + Aneurysm With TaurusElite

[PMID 40379370](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40379370/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

70 歲男 — type 0 bicuspid AS + ascending aortic aneurysm 50 mm。Selected **TaurusElite** (Chinese self-expanding TAVR with retrievable + repositionable design) for controlled deployment and ability to recapture if mal-positioned in raphe-free anatomy。Successful deployment, no PVL, aneurysm conservatively managed at 50 mm。

**教學重點**:
> **Retrievable / repositionable TAVR systems** (Evolut FX, Navitor, TaurusElite) are preferred for **type 0 bicuspid + aneurysmal aorta** — anatomy unpredictability + frame interaction with aneurysmal wall demands the ability to abort and re-deploy.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Pre-procedural CTA: type 0 bicuspid AS + ascending aneurysm 50 mm。](../images/tavi-complications/40379370_Qin_2025/fig-01_p3.jpeg)

![TaurusElite deployment with retrieval-and-redeploy capability — final position confirmed。](../images/tavi-complications/40379370_Qin_2025/fig-02_p4.jpeg)
:::

#### 13.7 Rehan 2025 — IVL-Enabled TAVR in Heavily Calcified Bicuspid AS

[PMID 41123533](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41123533/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

74 歲男 — type 1 bicuspid AS with **circumferential annular calcification** (Agatston 4500)。Direct TAVR predicted high risk of annular rupture or PVL。**Strategy**: (1) **intravascular lithotripsy (IVL)** with Shockwave 12 mm balloon at the annulus — fracture calcium plates; (2) subsequent TAVR with Evolut Pro+ 26 mm — uneventful, mild PVL only。

**教學重點**:
> **IVL pre-treatment is emerging for heavily calcified bicuspid annulus** — fractures circumferential calcium without high-pressure balloon trauma; reduces both rupture and PVL risk. Currently off-label for aortic annulus; published case-series support feasibility.

::: {layout-ncol=3}

#### 13.8 Alasnag 2020 — 3D Model Guiding TAVR in Coarctation

[PMID 34317241](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34317241/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2020

55 歲女 severe AS + uncorrected coarctation。**3D-printed patient-specific model** used pre-procedurally to (1) test sheath passage through CoA segment, (2) simulate TAVR delivery system manoeuvring, (3) plan custom strategy for potential bailout。Procedural simulation guided **transcarotid TAVR access** (avoiding TF route obstructed by CoA)。

**教學重點**:
> **Patient-specific 3D printing pre-procedural simulation** is invaluable for unusual anatomy (CoA, dextrocardia, complex aortopathy). Bench-tests delivery system passage and exposes hidden conflicts before committing in vivo. Transcarotid is a viable alternative when TF is anatomically prohibited.

## 14. Valve-in-Valve / Redo TAVR / Explantation

> **教學重點**：ViV、redo TAVR、TAV-explantation 是 TAVR 普及後的新興議題。Bioprosthetic frame 與 transcatheter delivery system 的 mechanical interaction 可能造成 strut inversion、frame distortion、unexpected complications。

**案例庫共 2 篇**（已下載 2）。

---

#### 14.1 Reisinger 2024 — Perceval ViV-TAVR: Perception Is Not Always Reality

[PMID 39295795](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39295795/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2024

72 歲女 — 之前 sutureless **Perceval AVR** 5 年前，現 structural valve degeneration（peak 80 mmHg, mean 50 mmHg）。Pre-procedural CT measurements 看似 acceptable，但 ViV 過程中 SAPIEN 3 26 mm deployment 出現 **unexpected frame distortion** — Perceval's collapsible frame did not provide rigid landing zone like rigid surgical bioprostheses。Final result mild PVL，但 case 教訓 — Perceval 等 sutureless valves 有 unique behaviour during ViV，不能直接套用 standard ViV sizing。

**教學重點**:
> **Perceval ViV is technically different from standard ViV** — its collapsible nitinol frame interacts unpredictably with TAVR delivery system. Pre-procedural CT measurements may underestimate complexity. Consider supra-annular self-expanding TAVR (Evolut) for more controlled deployment. Bench testing with patient-specific 3D model recommended.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Pre-procedural CT: Perceval AVR with structural valve degeneration; CT-measured valve dimensions。](../images/tavi-complications/39295795_Reisinger_2024/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![ViV deployment: SAPIEN 3 26 mm with unexpected frame distortion against collapsible Perceval frame。](../images/tavi-complications/39295795_Reisinger_2024/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Post-deployment angiography: mild PVL, suboptimal but acceptable result。](../images/tavi-complications/39295795_Reisinger_2024/fig-03_p4.jpeg)

![Workflow lessons: Perceval ViV requires special pre-procedural simulation, not standard ViV sizing。](../images/tavi-complications/39295795_Reisinger_2024/fig-04_p5.jpeg)
:::

#### 14.2 Batta 2022 — Strut Inversion During ViV-TAVR

[PMID 35493797](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35493797/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2022

68 歲男 — 之前 SAVR (Magna 23 mm) 7 年前，現 SVD。ViV with Evolut R 26 mm — during deployment, **distal strut of Evolut R inverted** when crossing the rigid Magna frame — created focal frame distortion + acute moderate PVL。**Bailout**: balloon post-dilation with 24 mm True Balloon → strut re-aligned; PVL reduced to mild。

**教學重點**:
> **Strut inversion is a rare ViV complication** when self-expanding TAVR is deployed against a rigid surgical frame. Recognise on fluoroscopy: focal strut deflection / asymmetric frame contour. Bailout = balloon post-dilation to re-align inverted struts. Pre-procedural CT must assess surgical frame rigidity + planning prosthesis depth.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-procedural fluoroscopy: SAVR Magna 23 mm with SVD, planning Evolut R ViV。](../images/tavi-complications/35493797_Batta_2022/fig-01_p3.jpeg)

![Strut inversion during deployment: focal distal strut inverted against Magna frame (red arrow)。](../images/tavi-complications/35493797_Batta_2022/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Post-balloon-dilation rescue: strut re-aligned; PVL reduced to mild。](../images/tavi-complications/35493797_Batta_2022/fig-03_p3.jpeg)
:::

## 15. Heart failure / Cardiogenic shock / ECMO / Pulmonary hypertension

> **教學重點**：Severe AS + cardiogenic shock + dynamic LVOTO 是 TAVR 高風險場景。VA-ECMO 提供 procedural haemodynamic support 但會增加 LV afterload；ECMO weaning 時機與藥物配合決定 outcome。

**案例庫共 1 篇**（已下載 1）。

---

#### 15.1 Torrado 2024 — Impact of VA-ECMO on Dynamic LV Outflow Obstruction After TAVR

[PMID 38264301](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38264301/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2024

74 歲女 — severe AS + cardiogenic shock。VA-ECMO support pre-TAVR for haemodynamic stabilisation。Post-TAVR (SAPIEN 3 23 mm) acute development of **dynamic LVOTO with SAM** — exacerbated by ECMO afterload。Counter-intuitive management: **ECMO weaning while increasing volume + esmolol** → SAM resolves。Case demonstrates the haemodynamic paradox: ECMO support solves cardiogenic shock but creates dynamic LVOT obstruction in vulnerable anatomy。

**教學重點**:
> **VA-ECMO + post-TAVR LVOTO is a haemodynamic paradox** — ECMO retrograde flow increases LV afterload, predisposing to SAM in already-vulnerable LV geometry. Recognise: SAM appears or worsens after ECMO initiation. Treatment: ECMO weaning + volume + β-blocker. Pre-procedural identification of high-risk anatomy (small LV, septal hypertrophy, EF >70%) is critical.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![Pre-procedural TTE: severe AS + small LV cavity, cardiogenic shock。](../images/tavi-complications/38264301_Torrado_2024/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Post-TAVR + ECMO TEE: dynamic LVOTO with SAM, exacerbated by ECMO afterload。](../images/tavi-complications/38264301_Torrado_2024/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Counter-intuitive management: ECMO weaning + volume + esmolol — SAM resolves。](../images/tavi-complications/38264301_Torrado_2024/fig-03_p3.jpeg)
:::

## 16. Procedural rescue / Bailout / Snare / Wire loss / Recapture

> **教學重點**：TAVR 過程中可能遇到 wire loss、device failure、snare-and-recapture、buckling 等 unique technical challenges。Operator 必備工具：snare set (Goose Neck, EnSnare, ONE Snare), AV loop technique, transseptal access, contralateral femoral approach。

**案例庫共 4 篇**（已下載 4）。

---

#### 16.1 Fernández-Cordón 2025 — LV Wire Loss During TAVR: Antegrade + Retrograde Solution

[PMID 40541354](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40541354/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

71 歲女 TAVR — **LV wire accidentally lost** into LV during deployment (Lunderquist wire kinked + retracted into LV cavity, separated from delivery system)。Standard retrograde retrieval failed — wire tip embedded in trabeculae。**Combined approach**: (1) trans-septal antegrade access from venous side; (2) snare from antegrade route grasping the LV wire fragment; (3) retrograde delivery system removed; (4) wire fragment retrieved through trans-septal sheath。No haemodynamic compromise; TAVR completed with new wire。

**教學重點**:
> **LV wire loss is a rare but feared complication** — wire fragment in LV can cause arrhythmia, embolisation, or LV perforation. Combined antegrade (trans-septal) + retrograde (retrograde aortic) approach allows snare-grasping from both sides. Time-critical: do not waste time on prolonged retrograde-only attempts.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![LV wire loss event: Lunderquist wire kinked and separated, fragment in LV cavity (red arrow)。](../images/tavi-complications/40541354_Fern_ndez-Cord_n_2025/fig-01_p3.jpeg)

![Combined approach setup: trans-septal antegrade + retrograde aortic catheters。](../images/tavi-complications/40541354_Fern_ndez-Cord_n_2025/fig-02_p4.jpeg)

![Snare-grasping the LV wire fragment from antegrade side。](../images/tavi-complications/40541354_Fern_ndez-Cord_n_2025/fig-03_p4.jpeg)

![Retrieval of wire fragment through trans-septal sheath。](../images/tavi-complications/40541354_Fern_ndez-Cord_n_2025/fig-04_p5.jpeg)

![Subsequent successful TAVR completion with new wire。](../images/tavi-complications/40541354_Fern_ndez-Cord_n_2025/fig-05_p6.jpeg)
:::

---

#### 16.2 Ghoneem 2025 — Buckling Under Pressure: Evolut FX Failure to Recapture

[PMID 40250941](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40250941/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

73 歲man Evolut FX 26 mm TAVR — **delivery system malfunction**: during attempted recapture (for repositioning), the **catheter buckled** within the femoral artery — recapture failure → valve partially deployed and could not be retrieved。**Bailout**: deploy completely + accept slightly low position → minor PVL，需 second TAV-in-TAV (SAPIEN 3 23 mm) at higher position 為 sealing。

**教學重點**:
> **Delivery system buckling during recapture is a Evolut FX–specific concern** — catheter shaft fatigue from repeated manipulation. Prevention: minimise unnecessary recapture attempts; if recapture fails, commit to deployment rather than persisting. **TAV-in-TAV is the workhorse bailout** for any deploy-and-cannot-reposition scenario.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![Evolut FX 26 mm partial deployment with attempted recapture。](../images/tavi-complications/40250941_Ghoneem_2025/fig-01_p2.jpeg)

![Catheter buckling within femoral artery — recapture failure (red arrow)。](../images/tavi-complications/40250941_Ghoneem_2025/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Decision: complete deployment with low position; accept minor PVL。](../images/tavi-complications/40250941_Ghoneem_2025/fig-03_p4.jpeg)

![TAV-in-TAV with SAPIEN 3 23 mm at higher position for sealing — final result。](../images/tavi-complications/40250941_Ghoneem_2025/fig-04_p5.jpeg)
:::

#### 16.3 Vu 2025 — Snare-Assisted Management of Nose Cone Entrapment

[PMID 39963234](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39963234/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

69 歲女 ACURATE neo2 TAVR — **nose cone entrapment** in subaortic chordae after deployment — could not retract delivery system normally。**Bailout**: contralateral femoral access + EnSnare 18-30 mm advanced retrograde → snare grasped the nose cone tip → coordinated traction released entrapment without chordal rupture。

**教學重點**:
> **Nose cone entrapment in subaortic chords / mitral apparatus** is a rare but reported complication of self-expanding TAVR with prominent nose cones. Bailout: contralateral femoral snare to grasp the nose cone tip + coordinated traction. Avoid forceful pulling — risks chordal rupture and acute MR.

::: {layout-ncol=3}
![ACURATE neo2 nose cone entrapment in subaortic chordae after deployment。](../images/tavi-complications/39963234_Vu_2025/fig-01_p3.jpeg)

![Contralateral femoral access + EnSnare 18-30 mm grasping nose cone tip。](../images/tavi-complications/39963234_Vu_2025/fig-02_p4.jpeg)

![Coordinated traction releases entrapment without chordal rupture; final result clean。](../images/tavi-complications/39963234_Vu_2025/fig-03_p5.jpeg)
:::

#### 16.4 Attisano 2022 — BVF After TAVR Complicated by Balloon Rupture: Bail-Out TAV-in-TAV-in-SAVR

[PMID 36406923](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36406923/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2022

67 歲男 — TAVR (SAPIEN 3 26 mm) inside SAVR (Mitroflow 23 mm) — for ViV mismatch reduction, attempted **bioprosthetic valve fracture (BVF)** with 24 mm True Balloon @ 26 atm → **balloon ruptured** during BVF — fragments retained in left ventricle。**Bailout cascade**: (1) balloon fragments retrieved by snare; (2) TAVR partially crushed by ruptured balloon → second TAV (SAPIEN 3 23 mm) deployed inside the first → final TAV-in-TAV-in-SAVR construct。

**教學重點**:
> **BVF balloon rupture is a serious but salvageable complication** — risk highest at >24 atm. If rupture: (1) retrieve fragments via snare immediately, (2) assess TAVR integrity — may require second TAV. Prevention: use higher-pressure-rated balloons (BVF-specific Trio); slow stepwise inflation; avoid in heavily calcified frames where rupture risk is highest.

::: {layout-ncol=3}

![Balloon fragments retrieved by snare from LV cavity。](../images/tavi-complications/36406923_Attisano_2022/fig-03_p3.jpeg)

![Crushed TAVR frame — second TAV-in-TAV-in-SAVR planning。](../images/tavi-complications/36406923_Attisano_2022/fig-04_p4.jpeg)

![Second SAPIEN 3 23 mm deployed inside first TAVR — final layered construct。](../images/tavi-complications/36406923_Attisano_2022/fig-05_p4.jpeg)

![Post-deployment angiography: acceptable result, mild PVL only。](../images/tavi-complications/36406923_Attisano_2022/fig-06_p5.jpeg)

![Final TTE: gradient 12 mmHg, mild PVL, durable bailout result。](../images/tavi-complications/36406923_Attisano_2022/fig-07_p5.jpeg)

## 17. Device malfunction (Delivery system / Balloon / Sheath / Capsule)

> **教學重點**：Self-expanding TAVR system 罕見但重要的 device malfunction — chronic infolding、capsule demolition、balloon-expanding sheath conflict、delivery catheter rupture。Operator 必須知道 mid-procedure 的 fallback strategies。

**案例庫共 1 篇**（已下載 1）。

---

#### 17.1 Hu 2026 — Chronically Infolded Self-Expanding Aortic Valve

[PMID 41811287](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41811287/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2026

71 歲男 — Evolut Pro+ TAVR 2 年前。Routine follow-up CT 顯示 **chronic frame infolding** at one cell — distortion noticed without acute symptoms。Initial concern: ongoing structural valve degeneration。Heart Team review: post-deployment frame deformation may have occurred at index procedure undetected by post-deployment angiography。**Strategy**: TAV-in-TAV with SAPIEN 3 23 mm — re-stretches the infolded Evolut frame; new internal sealing surface achieved。Symptomatic improvement at 3 months。

**教學重點**:
> **Chronic frame infolding is a rare delayed device malfunction** — can be asymptomatic for months/years before causing PVL or gradient progression. Routine post-TAVR CT should evaluate frame geometry, not just valve function. **TAV-in-TAV is the established treatment** for frame deformation — re-stretches the infolded segment.

::: {layout-ncol=3}

![TAV-in-TAV planning: SAPIEN 3 23 mm to re-stretch infolded segment。](../images/tavi-complications/41811287_Hu_2026/fig-03_p5.png)

![SAPIEN 3 23 mm deployment inside the deformed Evolut frame — re-stretching effect。](../images/tavi-complications/41811287_Hu_2026/fig-04_p5.png)

![Post-deployment CT: frame geometry restored; SAPIEN 3 sealing surface seated。](../images/tavi-complications/41811287_Hu_2026/fig-05_p6.png)

## 18. Special populations / Comorbidity (Hematologic / Amyloid / Pregnancy / Pediatric)

> **教學重點**：TAVR 在 special populations 需個別考量：hematologic neoplasm 的 thrombo-haemorrhagic balance、amyloid 的 progressive AS phenotype、pregnancy 的 fetal radiation exposure 與 anticoagulation、pediatric 的 LAMPOON for TMVR。

**案例庫共 1 篇**（已下載 1）。

---

#### 18.1 Mussayev 2025 — First Pediatric LAMPOON for TMVR (Valve-in-Ring)

[PMID 40973330](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40973330/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2025

12 歲男童 — congenital mitral valve disease，過去 mitral annuloplasty ring (Carpentier ring 26 mm)，現 prosthetic ring dehiscence + severe MR。Heart Team 選擇 **valve-in-ring TMVR with prophylactic LAMPOON** (Laceration of Anterior Mitral leaflet to Prevent Outflow Obstruction) — small LV cavity in pediatric anatomy 增加 LVOTO risk。LAMPOON via Astato XS 20 wire + RF energy → anterior mitral leaflet split → SAPIEN 3 23 mm valve-in-ring deployment。Post-procedure: no LVOTO (gradient 5 mmHg), MR resolved。

**教學重點**:
> **First reported pediatric LAMPOON** — extends adult valve-in-ring TMVR techniques to small LV anatomy. LAMPOON splits anterior mitral leaflet to prevent it from being pulled into LVOT during TMVR deployment. Critical for pediatric / small-LV cohort where LVOTO risk is high.

## 19. Bowel / GI / Non-cardiac collateral

> **教學重點**：TAVR 雖屬心臟手術，但 systemic embolisation、collateral haemodynamic effects 可能造成 GI ischaemia、bowel necrosis 等 non-cardiac complications。Pre-procedural 完整 imaging review 不能只看 cardiac view。

**案例庫共 1 篇**（已下載 1）。

---

#### 19.1 Abu-Much 2020 — Don't Trust the Imaging: Necrotic Bowel After TAVR Through Aortic Stent Graft

[PMID 34317168](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34317168/) ｜ JACC Case Rep 2020

76 歲男 — 之前 EVAR (endovascular aneurysm repair) 5 年前，現 severe AS。TAVR via TF route through the existing aortic stent graft — procedure uneventful。Post-TAVR D2 acute abdomen — CT shows **necrotic bowel** (mesenteric ischaemia)。Mechanism: TAVR delivery system traversal through stent graft caused **mechanical disruption of mural thrombus** → embolic showering to mesenteric arteries。Emergency laparotomy with bowel resection — survived。

**教學重點**:
> **Pre-existing aortic stent grafts harbour mural thrombus** — TAVR sheath traversal can mechanically dislodge it, causing distal embolisation. Pre-procedural CT must (1) identify mural thrombus, (2) assess graft inner luminal smoothness, (3) consider transcaval / transcarotid alternative if thrombus burden high. Post-TAVR new abdominal pain → urgent CT abdomen with contrast.

::: {layout-ncol=2}

![TAVR delivery system traversal — mechanical disruption of mural thrombus。](../images/tavi-complications/34317168_Abu-Much_2020/fig-02_p3.jpeg)

![Post-TAVR D2 CT: necrotic bowel from mesenteric embolisation。](../images/tavi-complications/34317168_Abu-Much_2020/fig-03_p3.jpeg)

> **教學重點**：TAVR 整體 outcome 不只關於 procedural success — **transitional care、readmission reduction、long-term autopsy findings** 是新興研究領域。
